[[File:Hostile terrain lizardccg.JPG|thumb|right|A ''gara'' delivering a deadly strike.]]
A '''''gara''''' is a dangerous lizard found in the [[Aiel Waste]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Gara}}

Thick and around two feet long, a ''gara'' has bronze scales and yellow stripes. The venom released in its bite is a clear oily fluid. The bite is strong enough to go through a boot and venomous enough to kill a bull. Though dangerously deadly if stumbled upon, a ''gara'' is slow enough to be avoided easily by a person who knows its danger.{{ref/book|4|48}} Its meat tastes rather like chicken.{{ref/book|5|21}}

==Parallels==
* from its description, it is likely the gara is meant to be a variant on the {{wp|gila monster}}. In our world, they are slow-moving but only moderately venomous, albeit highly painful.
